metadata.description: PubMed search tools for Claude — a local PubMed MCP server bundled with search, reference-verification and literature-review skills, plus an optional Unpaywall plugin.

plugins.name: pubmed
plugins.description: PubMed search toolkit: bundled local PubMed MCP server (10 tools) + skills for searching with hyperlinked citations, reference verification, key-paper finding, and PubMed-only literature reviews (numeric extraction to Excel/slides).

plugins.name: unpaywall
plugins.description: Optional: find legal open-access copies of a paper by DOI with the Unpaywall API, and optionally save the PDF. Sends the DOI and your UNPAYWALL_EMAIL to Unpaywall.
